newsitem.title: EGYPT: German tourists rescued from boat in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: German tourists rescued from boat in Egypt.

text.p: Egyptian police on Thursday rescued 25 German tourists unhurt after their cruise boat ran aground in the Nile in southern Egypt, security sources said.
"All the tourists and the 20-man crew aboard the boat Rosa Blanca were rescued," one of them told Reuters. "The tourists continued their journey to Cairo in buses."
He said the cause of the accident near Minya, 240 km (150 miles) south of Cairo, was pilot error.
Earlier this month nine foreign tourists and Egyptians died and 11 were missing after their tourist boat, Princess Jihan, capsized in the Nile in a freak storm.
